question: How does an employee submit an expense reimbursement request?
text: Employees submit expenses through the expense portal, attaching a receipt and selecting the appropriate expense category. Manager approval is required before the request routes to Finance for payment processing.
content:
How does an employee submit an expense reimbursement request?

Employees submit expenses through the expense portal, attaching a receipt and selecting the appropriate expense category. Manager approval is required before the request routes to Finance for payment processing.

question: What is the maximum reimbursable amount without pre-approval?
text: Expenses under $200 do not require pre-approval and can be submitted directly for reimbursement. Expenses of $200 or more require manager pre-approval before the purchase is made, documented in the expense portal.
content:
What is the maximum reimbursable amount without pre-approval?

Expenses under $200 do not require pre-approval and can be submitted directly for reimbursement. Expenses of $200 or more require manager pre-approval before the purchase is made, documented in the expense portal.

question: How long does expense reimbursement take to process?
text: Approved expense reports are reimbursed within 5 to 7 business days via direct deposit to the employee's payroll account. Reports submitted with missing receipts are held until the required documentation is provided.
content:
How long does expense reimbursement take to process?

Approved expense reports are reimbursed within 5 to 7 business days via direct deposit to the employee's payroll account. Reports submitted with missing receipts are held until the required documentation is provided.

question: What receipts are required for expense reimbursement?
text: An itemized receipt is required for any expense over $25, showing the vendor, date, and amount. A credit card statement alone is not sufficient documentation for reimbursement purposes.
content:
What receipts are required for expense reimbursement?

An itemized receipt is required for any expense over $25, showing the vendor, date, and amount. A credit card statement alone is not sufficient documentation for reimbursement purposes.

question: Are meals during business travel reimbursable, and up to what amount?
text: Meals during business travel are reimbursable up to $75 per day, itemized by meal, without needing pre-approval as long as the trip itself was approved. Alcohol is reimbursable only up to $25 per day and must be itemized separately.
content:
Are meals during business travel reimbursable, and up to what amount?

Meals during business travel are reimbursable up to $75 per day, itemized by meal, without needing pre-approval as long as the trip itself was approved. Alcohol is reimbursable only up to $25 per day and must be itemized separately.

question: Can personal expenses be reimbursed if mixed with a business trip?
text:
Personal expenses are not reimbursable even when incurred during an approved business trip; only the business-related portion of any mixed expense is eligible. Employees must clearly itemize and separate personal charges when submitting the report.

==================================================
content:
Can personal expenses be reimbursed if mixed with a business trip?

Personal expenses are not reimbursable even when incurred during an approved business trip; only the business-related portion of any mixed expense is eligible. Employees must clearly itemize and separate personal charges when submitting the report.

question: What is the company's policy on booking flights for business travel?
text: All business flights must be booked through the approved corporate travel platform to ensure duty-of-care tracking and negotiated rates. Booking outside the platform requires an exception approved by the employee's manager in advance.
content:
What is the company's policy on booking flights for business travel?

All business flights must be booked through the approved corporate travel platform to ensure duty-of-care tracking and negotiated rates. Booking outside the platform requires an exception approved by the employee's manager in advance.

question: Is business class travel ever approved?
text: Business class is approved only for flights longer than 6 hours in the air or for employees with a documented medical accommodation. All other domestic and short-haul travel is booked in economy class.
content:
Is business class travel ever approved?

Business class is approved only for flights longer than 6 hours in the air or for employees with a documented medical accommodation. All other domestic and short-haul travel is booked in economy class.

question: How far in advance must business travel be booked?
text: Travel should be booked at least 14 days in advance whenever possible to secure better fares and availability. Last-minute travel under 14 days requires manager approval noting the business reason for short notice.
content:
How far in advance must business travel be booked?

Travel should be booked at least 14 days in advance whenever possible to secure better fares and availability. Last-minute travel under 14 days requires manager approval noting the business reason for short notice.

question: What is the per-diem rate for international travel?
text: The international per-diem rate is $85 per day for meals and incidentals, adjusted for high-cost cities such as London, Tokyo, or San Francisco, where the rate increases to $110 per day. Per-diem amounts are published in the finance intranet page by city tier.
content:
What is the per-diem rate for international travel?

The international per-diem rate is $85 per day for meals and incidentals, adjusted for high-cost cities such as London, Tokyo, or San Francisco, where the rate increases to $110 per day. Per-diem amounts are published in the finance intranet page by city tier.

question: Who approves travel requests above the standard budget?
text:
Travel exceeding $3,000 in total cost requires department head approval in addition to the direct manager's approval. This includes conference travel packages that bundle airfare, lodging, and registration fees.

==================================================
content:

Travel exceeding $3,000 in total cost requires department head approval in addition to the direct manager's approval. This includes conference travel packages that bundle airfare, lodging, and registration fees.

question: How often are customers invoiced for their subscription?
text: Customers on monthly plans are invoiced on the same calendar day each month as their initial signup date. Customers on annual plans are invoiced once per year, with a renewal notice sent 30 days before the renewal date.
content:
How often are customers invoiced for their subscription?

Customers on monthly plans are invoiced on the same calendar day each month as their initial signup date. Customers on annual plans are invoiced once per year, with a renewal notice sent 30 days before the renewal date.

question: What payment methods does the company accept from customers?
text: Meridian Cloud accepts credit card and ACH bank transfer for self-serve customers, and additionally accepts wire transfer for enterprise customers on annual contracts. Payment method changes can be made by the customer's billing administrator in the account settings.
content:
What payment methods does the company accept from customers?

Meridian Cloud accepts credit card and ACH bank transfer for self-serve customers, and additionally accepts wire transfer for enterprise customers on annual contracts. Payment method changes can be made by the customer's billing administrator in the account settings.

question: How does a customer request a billing correction?
text: Customers submit billing correction requests through the in-app support widget or by emailing the billing support alias, including the invoice number and description of the discrepancy. Corrections are reviewed and resolved within 5 business days.
content:
How does a customer request a billing correction?

Customers submit billing correction requests through the in-app support widget or by emailing the billing support alias, including the invoice number and description of the discrepancy. Corrections are reviewed and resolved within 5 business days.

question: What is the grace period before a subscription is suspended for non-payment?
text: Accounts with a failed payment enter a 14-day grace period during which service continues while the customer resolves the payment issue. If payment is not resolved within the grace period, the account is downgraded to a restricted read-only state.
content:

Accounts with a failed payment enter a 14-day grace period during which service continues while the customer resolves the payment issue. If payment is not resolved within the grace period, the account is downgraded to a restricted read-only state.

question: How are annual subscription plans billed compared to monthly plans?
text: Annual plans are billed as a single upfront payment for the full year, at a 15% discount compared to paying monthly. Monthly plans are billed in recurring installments with no long-term commitment and can be canceled at any time.

Annual plans are billed as a single upfront payment for the full year, at a 15% discount compared to paying monthly. Monthly plans are billed in recurring installments with no long-term commitment and can be canceled at any time.

question: Can a customer request a refund after canceling their subscription?
text:
Monthly plan cancellations are not refunded for the current billing period, but access continues until the period ends. Annual plans canceled within the first 30 days are eligible for a prorated refund; cancellations after 30 days are not refunded.

question: What is the company's payroll schedule?
text: Employees are paid on a semi-monthly schedule, on the 15th and last business day of each month. If a pay date falls on a weekend or holiday, payment is issued on the preceding business day.
content:

question: How does an employee set up or change direct deposit?
text: Direct deposit is set up or updated through the payroll portal by entering bank routing and account numbers. Changes submitted before the payroll cutoff, typically 5 business days before pay date, take effect in the next paycheck.
content:

question: When are annual tax forms (W-2 equivalents) issued to employees?
text: Annual tax documents are issued electronically through the payroll portal by January 31 each year, with a physical copy available on request. Employees can access prior years' tax documents through the same portal for record-keeping.
content:

question: How are payroll discrepancies corrected?
text: Employees report payroll discrepancies to the Payroll team within 5 business days of the pay date for fastest resolution. Corrections identified before the next payroll cutoff are included in the following pay cycle; urgent cases may be issued as an off-cycle payment.

Performance and referral bonuses are paid as a separate off-cycle payment rather than combined with regular salary, typically within 30 days of approval. Bonus payments are subject to a different, often higher, default tax withholding rate.

question: What spending threshold requires manager approval before purchasing?
text: Purchases of $500 or more require direct manager approval before a purchase order is issued. Purchases under $500 can be made using a corporate card without additional approval, subject to standard expense policy.
content:
What spending threshold requires manager approval before purchasing?

Purchases of $500 or more require direct manager approval before a purchase order is issued. Purchases under $500 can be made using a corporate card without additional approval, subject to standard expense policy.

question: What spending threshold requires finance department approval?
text: Purchases exceeding $10,000 require additional approval from the Finance department beyond the standard manager approval, including a review of budget availability. Purchases exceeding $50,000 also require CFO sign-off.

question: How long does vendor onboarding take before a purchase order is issued?

text:
Emergency purchases under $1,000 can be made on a corporate card with manager notification, followed by a retroactive purchase order filed within 3 business days. Purchases above $1,000 require verbal approval from Finance before the purchase, even in an emergency.

question: How does a vendor submit an invoice for payment?

question: What happens if a vendor invoice is disputed?
text: Disputed invoices are flagged in the accounts payable system and the requesting department is notified to resolve the discrepancy with the vendor. Payment is held until the dispute is resolved or a corrected invoice is submitted.

question: How are department budgets allocated each fiscal year?
text: Department budgets are proposed by department heads and approved by Finance and executive leadership during annual planning in Q4, based on headcount plans and strategic priorities. Approved budgets are loaded into the finance system at the start of the fiscal year.
content:

question: What happens if a department exceeds its quarterly budget?
text: Departments exceeding their quarterly budget by more than 10% must submit a variance explanation to Finance and may face a spending freeze on non-essential purchases for the remainder of the quarter.
content:

question: Who approves budget reallocation requests mid-year?
text: Mid-year budget reallocation between categories within the same department requires department head approval. Reallocation between different departments additionally requires Finance approval to ensure overall budget integrity.
content:

question: How does an employee request a corporate card?
text: Corporate card requests are submitted through the finance portal with manager approval, and cards are typically issued within 5 business days. Cards are tied to the employee's expense profile and default spending limit for their role.
content:
How does an employee request a corporate card?

question: What is the monthly spending limit on a standard corporate card?
text: Standard corporate cards have a default monthly limit of $2,500, which can be increased temporarily for specific business needs, such as event planning, with manager and Finance approval.
content:
What is the monthly spending limit on a standard corporate card?

Standard corporate cards have a default monthly limit of $2,500, which can be increased temporarily for specific business needs, such as event planning, with manager and Finance approval.

question: What purchases are prohibited on a corporate card?
text: Corporate cards cannot be used for personal purchases, cash advances, or purchases from unapproved vendor categories such as gambling. Any prohibited transaction identified during reconciliation must be reimbursed by the employee immediately.
content:
What purchases are prohibited on a corporate card?

Corporate cards cannot be used for personal purchases, cash advances, or purchases from unapproved vendor categories such as gambling. Any prohibited transaction identified during reconciliation must be reimbursed by the employee immediately.

question: What happens if a corporate card charge is not reconciled on time?
text: Unreconciled charges after 30 days trigger an automated reminder, and after 60 days the card may be temporarily suspended until outstanding reconciliations are completed. Repeated late reconciliation may result in card privileges being revoked.
content:
What happens if a corporate card charge is not reconciled on time?

Unreconciled charges after 30 days trigger an automated reminder, and after 60 days the card may be temporarily suspended until outstanding reconciliations are completed. Repeated late reconciliation may result in card privileges being revoked.

question: How is a lost or stolen corporate card reported?
text:
Employees report a lost or stolen corporate card immediately to the card issuer's hotline to freeze the account, then notify Finance so a replacement card can be issued. Any unauthorized charges identified are disputed directly with the card issuer.

==================================================

question: What is the dispute process for a declined customer payment?
text: When a customer payment is declined, an automated retry occurs after 3 days, followed by an email notification to the billing contact. If payment continues to fail, the standard 14-day grace period applies before service restrictions begin.

question: What is the year-end close process for the finance team?

question: How does an employee request reimbursement for a home internet stipend?
